one_idea.line: Yes. Both cuts still carry the auditor opening old pages and finding money or a skeleton. Every chip, including the new l_l_lead_4 and l_l_listfirst_1, quotes or closely glosses what he says in that beat and adds no second idea; no chip acts out a line. The chips you changed now pulse only on their own words. The older chips l_caveat, l_cust, l_next and l_last still pulse on words not in their text (l_fell, l_twist, l_hindsight).

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. No chip has a digit. l_face_3 now reads 'YOUR FINANCE LEAD'S UNREAD FOLDER' with no number, and l_l_listfirst_1 drops his '10 years' rather than adding one. $195,000 and $33,000 come from datasets bill-billed and bill-after (Tom's Hardware, the family's account), with the caveat chips kept. The real-page figures in l_tenant and l_krafton are unchanged.
